signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.body: How you sign in is separate from the accounts you connect.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.body: Continue with the method you signed up with.

legal: By continuing, you accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. Your data is never used for advertising.

errors.failedBody: Try again or choose another method.
errors.playServices: Google sign-in isn't available on this device. Choose another method.
errors.offline: Signing in needs an internet connection.

email.title: Continue with email
email.body: We'll send you a 6-digit sign-in code.
email.noAccount: We couldn't find an account with this email.
email.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again a little later.

verify.title: Enter the code
verify.body: Type the 6-digit code we sent to {email}.
verify.wrong: That code is incorrect. Try again.
verify.expired: The code has expired. Request a new one.

newAccount.title: A new account was created.
newAccount.body: You didn't have an account with this method. If you continue, you'll set up the new account.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.onboardingBody: Sign out to start with a different account.
